tests.name: flatten_ordered_map_hint
tests.intent: Probes flatten() and unflatten() round trip on an ordered_json object using the new emplace_hint and fast unflatten scanning logic.

tests.name: unflatten_parse_error_107
tests.intent: Verifies that unflatten() on a flat object with an invalid key not starting with a slash raises parse_error.107.

tests.name: unflatten_parse_error_108
tests.intent: Verifies that unflatten() with an invalid tilde escape in a pointer key raises parse_error.108.

tests.name: patch_plain_add_object_member
tests.intent: Probes the optimized plain patch path for an 'add' operation on an object without escaping.

tests.name: patch_plain_add_array_element
tests.intent: Probes the optimized plain patch path for an 'add' operation inserting into an array.

tests.name: patch_plain_remove_object_member
tests.intent: Probes the optimized plain patch path for a 'remove' operation on an object member.

tests.name: patch_plain_replace_value
tests.intent: Probes the optimized plain patch path for a 'replace' operation.

tests.name: patch_plain_test_success
tests.intent: Probes the optimized plain patch path for a successful 'test' operation.

tests.name: diff_identical_keys_ordered_walk
tests.intent: Probes the optimized diff path that walks objects with identical keys in the same order together.

tests.name: diff_array_tails_optimization
tests.intent: Probes diff() handling of array tail additions and removals using buffer-based path generation.

tests.name: patch_fallback_with_escapes
tests.intent: Probes fallback patch path when tilde escapes are present in the path string.

tests.name: flatten_deeply_nested_structure
tests.intent: Probes flatten() with deep nesting and array indices to exercise path segment in-place appending.

tests.name: unflatten_array_prefix_detection
tests.intent: Probes unflatten() correctly identifying array prefixes where key '0' indicates an array container.

tests.name: diff_nested_objects_and_types
tests.intent: Probes diff() between complex objects with mixed types and nested structures.

tests.name: patch_add_array_append_dash
tests.intent: Probes plain patch 'add' operation appending to an array using the '-' index token.

tests.name: patch_remove_array_element
tests.intent: Probes plain patch 'remove' operation on a specific array index.

tests.name: diff_empty_source_and_target
tests.intent: Probes diff() behavior when transitioning between empty and non-empty objects.

tests.name: unflatten_skipped_prefix_scan
tests.intent: Probes unflatten() correctness on sorted flat keys that share common prefixes.

tests.name: patch_test_failure_state
tests.intent: Probes patch behavior and exception handling when a plain 'test' operation fails.

tests.name: flatten_unflatten_roundtrip_complex
tests.intent: Probes a complete flatten and unflatten roundtrip on a rich JSON structure with all data types.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Exercises unflatten() on a flat object with duplicate sorted keys that trigger array_prefix_set duplicate checks and hash table operations.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Exercises patch() with move/copy/invalid operations to hit the default fallback branch and return false.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Exercises diff() between two complex nested objects with array tail removals and insertions to invoke diff_index_path and diff_array_tails.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Exercises unflatten() failing when a non-primitive value is provided as a leaf in the flat JSON structure.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Exercises diff() where objects have the same set of keys in a different order, invoking the slow path for object keys reordering.
